title: Interaction primitives and token harmonization for responsive cost dashboards
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Audit and reconcile interaction primitives and semantic token sets used across the cost dashboard, rollout controls, and SLO overlays. Deliver a Figma prototype with responsive chart variants, cost breakdown components, and a lightweight rollout toggle/slider pattern. Produce a token mapping sheet for engineering handoff and a short migration checklist for existing console pages.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Kickoff: scoped primitives (buttons, toggles, sliders, chips, badges, counters) + token families (color, elevation, spacing, type scale) for the cost dashboard and rollout controls. Mapped initial gaps against existing figma library.

2026-03-03 - Prototype v0: created responsive cost chart variants (compact, regular, wide) with prefixed semantic tokens (semantic-bg, semantic-ink, cost-positive, cost-negative, neutral-muted). Shared with PM and Eng for early feedback.
2026-03-05 - UX review: PM requests clearer affordance for streaming cost updates. Decided: add subtle shimmer + live-chip indicating 'live' state and a micro interaction for incoming token batches.

2026-03-06 - Accessibility check: contrast issues found in neutral-muted tokens at small sizes. Action: raise neutral-muted contrast by 8% and add explicit focus styles for keyboard users on rollout slider and canary badges.

2026-03-08 - Engineering sync: agreed on token naming (semantic-cost-positive/negative, interactive-primary/secondary, surface-elevation-1..4). Eng requested a migration plan for legacy tokens; added to attachments.

2026-03-09 - Design critique: suggested adding an 'explainable breakdown' pattern—expandable rows in the cost table that reveal sample traces, model versions, and route tag. Will prototype accordion-row variant.
2026-03-10 - Handoff prep: produced token mapping sheet (figma -> css/ts names), and an example React snippet for rollout slider integration with telemetry hooks.

2026-03-11 - Review feedback from Design Lead (Sana Patel): please tighten spacing tokens to a 4px baseline grid for dashboard cards and re-evaluate chart gutter at <600px widths. Also requested a lightweight animated transition for canary progress to indicate staged rollout.

2026-03-12 - Status: updated prototype with 3 responsive breakpoints, accessibility fixes applied, and added unit test guidance for focus styles. Ready for engineering QA and PM sign-off. Next: merge tokens to console-2026.03 release branch after Eng migration story completes.
Links referenced during updates: figma prototype, migration doc, PR #1223 for token exports, console-ux research notes.
outcome_criteria: Figma prototype reviewed and approved by PM and Eng
Token mapping sheet accepted by Eng with migration checklist
Accessibility contrast and keyboard navigation issues resolved
Implementation guidance (React snippets + CSS token names) published in repo PR
